name: boj_get_economic_indicator
description:
One Japanese economic indicator from FRED: gdp (real GDP, billions of chained 2015 yen, quarterly; JPNRGDPEXP), unemployment (%, monthly; LRUNTTTTJPM156S), exports, imports or trade_balance (goods, yen, monthly, seasonally adjusted; OECD XTEXVA01JPM664S, XTIMVA01JPM664S, XTNTVA01JPM664S, the balance being exports less imports).
Returns: series_code (FRED id, or IMF flow.key), series_id, label, source, observation_count and observations (date, value) oldest first, missing values dropped.
Inputs (none required): indicator (gdp, unemployment, exports, imports, trade_balance; default gdp); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD); recent_periods (1-500; default 10; the last N observations, used only when neither date is given).
For prices use boj_get_inflation; all series: boj_list_series. FRED series need FRED_API_KEY (config fred.api.key); without it they fail with a message saying so.
Example: {"indicator": "trade_balance", "start_date": "2025-01-01"}

recent_periods.description: The last N observations; used only when neither date is given
